faqs.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
faqs.a: Yes, we have several vegetarian dishes including Daal Makhani, Saag, and vegetable dishes. Ask us for the full veg menu.

faqs.q: Can I order a custom cake for a birthday?
faqs.a: We don't make cakes, but we can arrange a special dessert platter for celebrations. Let us know 24 hours in advance.

faqs.q: Is there parking?
faqs.a: Yes, we have a private parking area that fits up to 30 cars. Street parking is also available.

faqs.q: Do you accommodate large groups?
faqs.a: Yes! Groups up to 50 can be accommodated with advance booking. Corporate events and family gatherings welcome.

faqs.q: Are you halal certified?
faqs.a: Yes, all our meat is 100% halal certified.

faqs.q: What is the minimum delivery order?
faqs.a: Minimum order for delivery is PKR 800. Delivery charge is PKR 80 within 5km, PKR 120 beyond 5km.

faqs.q: How can I track my delivery?
faqs.a: Our delivery rider will share their contact number when the order is dispatched. You can call them directly.

businesses.booking_note: For table reservations, share this link. For corporate catering, ask for Sarmad directly.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to buy a property?
faqs.a: CNIC copy, two passport photos, and the purchase funds. Our agent guides you through the full documentation process.

faqs.q: Do you verify properties before listing?
faqs.a: Yes. We conduct a title verification and site visit before listing any property.

faqs.q: What is your turnaround time for finding a rental?
faqs.a: We typically find suitable options within 3–5 business days depending on your requirements and budget.

faqs.q: Can you manage my property if I'm abroad?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We handle everything — tenant sourcing, rent collection, and maintenance — and send you monthly reports.

faqs.q: Is there a fee for viewing properties?
faqs.a: No. Property viewings are completely free with no obligation.

businesses.name: ClearSkin Dermatology Clinic
businesses.tagline: Expert skin care you can trust.
businesses.ai_persona: Professional, reassuring, never provides medical diagnoses. Always recommends in-person consultation for specific concerns.
businesses.important_note: BRIO must never diagnose conditions or recommend specific treatments. Always say: 'Dr. Nadia will assess this during your consultation.'

location.address: House 45, Block C, Cavalry Ground Extension

faqs.q: Do I need a referral to visit?
faqs.a: No referral needed. You can book directly through us.

faqs.q: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.a: This varies by condition and treatment. Dr. Nadia will create a personalized plan during your first consultation.

faqs.q: Is the clinic hygienic and safe?
faqs.a: Yes. We maintain strict sterilization protocols and use single-use equipment where applicable.

faqs.q: Do you offer payment plans?
faqs.a: Yes, for packages of 3 or more sessions, we offer 50% upfront and 50% over the remaining sessions.

faqs.q: Can I book for someone else?
faqs.a: Yes, you can book on behalf of a family member. Please provide the patient's name and age when booking.

faqs.q: How is this different from a business consultant?
faqs.a: A consultant gives you answers. A coach develops your ability to find answers yourself. Bilal does both — strategy and execution.

faqs.q: What kind of businesses do you work with?
faqs.a: SMBs across all industries — retail, services, manufacturing, e-commerce. Revenue range: PKR 1M–500M annually.

faqs.q: How quickly will I see results?
faqs.a: Most clients see measurable changes in 60–90 days. Significant revenue growth typically shows in months 4–6.

faqs.q: Is the free discovery call really free?
faqs.a: 100% free, no strings attached. We talk, see if there's a fit, and you decide.

faqs.q: Can I do online sessions?
faqs.a: Yes. All sessions available via Zoom. Physical sessions available in Lahore only.
